projects.title: Videos.Recipes
projects.description: AI-powered SaaS that turns YouTube cooking videos into structured, searchable recipes — with tiered subscriptions, real-time extraction, and export to PDF or DOCX.
highlights: Extracts ingredients, steps, timings, and metadata from any cooking video URL
Tiered subscription billing via Paddle with webhook-driven entitlements
Full-text search and tag filtering across a personal recipe library
One-click export to PDF or DOCX for printing or sharing

projects.title: Clipmer
projects.description: Tray-based clipboard history manager for Linux. Keyboard-first popup with search, pinned items, notes, and auto-paste — built for Ubuntu on GNOME/Wayland.
highlights: Up to 200 deduplicated entries (text and images); pinned items persist across restarts
Instant search across content and inline notes attached to any entry
Auto-paste on Wayland via a companion GNOME Shell extension
Global shortcut (Ctrl+Shift+D), dark/light themes with custom accent, adjustable font size
Distributed as .deb and AppImage with a Next.js marketing site at clipmer.app
